Job Title: GenAI SRE Engineer

Experience: 68 Years
Job Type: Full-Time
Job Function: Site Reliability Engineering (SRE) / Cloud Operations / GenAI Infrastructure
Mandatory Skill: AWS Cloud
Key Skills: SRE, AWS, GenAI, LLM, Prometheus, Grafana, Datadog, Python, Bash, Disaster Recovery, Incident Management, Kubernetes

Job Summary

We are looking for an experienced GenAI SRE Engineer to ensure the reliability, availability, resilience, and performance of Generative AI (GenAI) systems and Large Language Model (LLM)-based platforms running in production.

The ideal candidate will have strong Site Reliability Engineering (SRE) and production operations experience, hands-on expertise with AWS cloud services, observability, automation, disaster recovery, and a working understanding of GenAI/LLM infrastructure and its operational challenges.

Key Responsibilities

Implement and manage monitoring, observability, logging, and alerting solutions for GenAI systems and services.
Design, implement, and maintain disaster recovery (DR) strategies, business continuity plans, and operational runbooks.
Monitor and optimize system performance, availability, scalability, and resource utilization across GenAI workloads.
Collaborate with engineering, DevOps, cloud, and platform teams to ensure high availability and reliability of AI services.
Define, measure, and track Service Level Indicators (SLIs), Service Level Objectives (SLOs), and Service Level Agreements (SLAs).
Participate in incident response, troubleshooting, root-cause analysis (RCA), and post-incident reviews.
Develop automation using Python or Bash to reduce manual operational effort and improve platform resilience.
Perform capacity planning, performance analysis, bottleneck identification, and infrastructure optimization.
Support production deployments, operational readiness, on-call activities, and continuous reliability improvements.
Identify and mitigate reliability risks associated with GenAI and LLM-based applications.

Required Skills and Experience

68 years of overall IT experience, including hands-on experience in SRE, production support, or infrastructure operations.
Strong hands-on experience with AWS cloud services and cloud infrastructure operations.
Experience with observability and monitoring tools such as Prometheus, Grafana, Datadog, New Relic, or ELK Stack.
Experience designing, implementing, and testing disaster recovery and business continuity solutions.
Strong understanding of performance monitoring, system tuning, scalability, and capacity planning.
Proficiency in Python or Bash scripting for automation and operational tooling.
Working knowledge of Generative AI, LLM infrastructure, and the reliability challenges of AI-powered applications.
Experience in incident management, production troubleshooting, escalation management, and on-call rotations.
Strong understanding of SRE principles, high availability, fault tolerance, and production reliability best practices.

Good to Have

Experience with Kubernetes and containerized deployments for AI/ML workloads.
Exposure to chaos engineering, fault injection, and resilience testing.
Familiarity with LLM serving, inference workloads, latency monitoring, and AI platform performance optimization.
Experience with Infrastructure as Code (Terraform or CloudFormation) and CI/CD pipelines.

Educational Qualifications

Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, or a related discipline.

Preferred Candidate Profile

Candidates with strong AWS, SRE, production operations, observability, disaster recovery, and automation experience, along with exposure to GenAI/LLM platforms, are encouraged to apply.

Keywords: GenAI SRE Engineer, Site Reliability Engineer, AWS SRE, Generative AI, LLM Infrastructure, Cloud Operations, Production Support, Prometheus, Grafana, Datadog, Python, Bash, Kubernetes, Disaster Recovery, Incident Management, SLI, SLO, SLA.
